# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

This project supports the most recent minor version of
`python-profiling` only.  Older releases may receive critical security
fixes on a best-effort basis.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** file a public issue for suspected security
vulnerabilities.  Instead, e-mail
[pythonbackport@proton.me](mailto:pythonbackport@proton.me) with a
detailed description of the issue and a reproducer (where possible).

We will acknowledge receipt within 72 hours and aim to publish a fix
within 30 days, depending on severity.
